slides.label: Verse 1
lines: My Lord and King
I’m delightfully loving You
more each day my Lord
I’m replete with Your love
Fully enveloped by Your presence my King

slides.label: Verse 2
lines: In You was life and immortality unveiled
That same life You have given me
Now I’m walking in the fullness of the
Blessings of the Gospel of Christ

slides.label: Verse 3
lines: CHORUS:
You are most adorably
beautiful my King
In every way, awesomely majestic
You are graciously merciful and kind
You are so holy, so good and righteous
You’re the loving Saviour, loving God

slides.label: Verse 4
lines: There’s a language of love spoken
by my heart beyond mere words can tell
The language of love that can
be heard, and touched
Only in You, Christ our Lord

slides.label: Verse 7
lines: On that day I will see You face to face
I will look into those eyes that loved me so
I will feel those hands that were nailed for me
I will kneel before those feet that were nailed for me

slides.label: Verse 8
lines: I will lay before You my Lord and King
I will be rolling from side to side
Thanking You Lord, for the price You paid for me
To be with You forever

slides.label: Verse 9
lines: With this love, I feel inside
I’ll be loving You for all eternity
